notes: One picture family: media.made.land. land[1] is the wallpaper of every feature row (three crops of it) and, at 42 %, the band behind the notes window; land[5] (else land[0]) is the backdrop of the plans. A dark page skips a light-toned land picture. sky, blur, sheet and field are not used.

screens_min 1: the opening's large frame takes the film, else the first lying screen; the five small windows take whatever screens, phones and photos are left and are simply fewer when there are fewer.
plans, faq, close, figures, a film and trust lines are optional; each is left out whole when missing.
A place (restaurant, hotel, shop) is not a fit: nothing here shows menu, hours, address or rooms, and it relies on made pictures, which places do not get.
